name: offstage
description: Keep UI, browser and macOS app work off your screen. Routes each test command to the cheapest isolation that can honestly run it — in place when it is already headless, a Linux container with Xvfb when a real window is needed, the macOS session lane (a second, logged-in account with its own display and input) for xcodebuild, simulators and app launches, and a disposable macOS VM for anything that could change the machine.
